summary: Backend-only verification of the storefront test-listing purge + shared filter hardening (iteration 57). Verified against preview URL that (a) /api/listings?sort=newest&limit=200 returns 0 titles matching the reserved LISTING_TEST_TITLE_RE prefixes and 0 seller_names matching ^e2e_; (b) /api/listings/count=4709 (~4710 as expected, 83 fewer post-purge); (c) /api/products?total=true returns total=4512 (unchanged); (d) /api/stores/56555665/listings returns [] (was 5 Stripe-removal seed items before); (e) all 3 new pytests in test_storefront_filter_regression.py pass; (f) 56 existing regression tests across products_fallback, pickup_30m_bump, url_safety, wallet_only_orders, wallet_timeline_and_resubmit, admin_payment_reviews, admin_deposits_bulk all pass (1 skipped). No regressions detected from filter tightening.
critical_code_review_comments: services/storefront_filter.py is a clean single source of truth — LISTING_TEST_TITLE_RE, SELLER_TEST_USERNAME_RE, PRODUCT_TEST_SKU_RE. Correctly consumed by server.py (_build_listings_query line 805, get_store_listings line 2859) and routers/products.py (_augment_with_listings line 540).
Case-insensitive matching via $options: 'i' correctly catches lowercase 'e2e listing abc'.
Minor: server.py is 7500+ lines — should be split into modules (already flagged in earlier iterations). Not a regression from this change.
test_credentials: Not required — all endpoints tested are public.
seed_data_creation: Regression test seeds & tears down 9 listings inside test_storefront_filter_regression.py — cleanup verified via finally-block delete_many/delete_one.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Storefront filter is now centralized in services/storefront_filter.py. When adding new test seeds in future iterations, prefix titles with any of: TEST_, E2E , E2E_, Timeline test, Follow Notif Test, Stripe removal, Bump Test, PRODUCTS_FALLBACK_FIXTURE, SYNC_TEST_, e2e_, OR use seller_name starting with e2e_ — the shared filter will keep them out of public /api/listings, /api/stores/{id}/listings, and the products fallback augmentation. If you seed listings without any of these prefixes they WILL appear on the storefront (e.g., 'Wallet-only order test 1787606094' currently visible — not blocked because it doesn't start with a reserved prefix; not in scope of this iteration).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Purge + filter hardening verified working as designed.
